warmup.name: Elephant walk
warmup.note: Hamstring nerve glide (movementbydavid step 1). Hinge forward, hands toward the floor, bend one knee, shift hips toward it so the other leg straightens. Tingling behind the straight knee is the point. Alternate.

warmup.name: Calf + soleus stretch
warmup.note: Ankle range for the deep squat. Calf: toes up on a plate, knee straight, lean in. Soleus: foot flat, push the knee past the toes as far as it goes. Knee past toes is good, not dangerous.

warmup.name: Supported deep squat hold
warmup.note: Hold a rack upright, sink as deep as the knee allows, heels down. Push knees forward and hips out. Right knee sets the depth: pressure is fine, a pinch means come up a bit.

warmup.name: Lunge pulses + couch stretch
warmup.dose: 10 pulses, then 30 s hold, per side
warmup.note: Half-kneeling, hands down, back toes anchored: lift the back knee off the floor, sink the hip, 10x. Then hold the couch stretch (or reach the arm up and over if couch is too much). Tuck the pelvis BEFORE you lean. You should feel it creep into the abs, never into the lower back.

warmup.name: Active hamstring stretch
warmup.note: Half-kneeling, front leg straight, heel down, hinge until you feel the stretch. Then PUSH the heel hard into the floor for the whole 30 s, so the hamstring works while it is long.

warmup.name: Kneeling rock-back
warmup.note: Knee flexion. On all fours with a pad under the knees, rock the hips back toward the heels with hands taking weight. Stop at pressure, never pain. Right knee: if your surgeon said flexion is mechanically blocked, rock only to where it stops and do not push.

warmup.name: 90/90 push-up
warmup.note: From 90/90, torso down over the front leg to the floor and back. Hands assist at first; goal is the glute lifting you unaided.

warmup.name: Elevated pancake
warmup.note: Replaces the straddle hold. Sit on a plate or step, legs wide, toes up, flat back, reach forward toward something at the same height. Track it: fingers, then elbows on the bench, then lower the seat.

A.session_notes: Shoulder press up (top 65, back-off 55), leg curl 45. Pulldown 55, pec deck 45, side bend 20, preacher 40 all hold. Pulldown: stop the set when form breaks, not when the arms do. Warm-up stays: hips, knees, hamstrings.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press - top set
exercises.notes: Machine: 60x5 was RPE 6 on 11-08 -> 65. Hold 65 until it is RPE 7, then 70. Barbell/DB variants: weights do not carry.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press - back-off
exercises.notes: Machine: 50x8 both sets, last at RPE 7 on 11-08 -> 55. Hold 55 until both sets are RPE 8 or less.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.notes: 40x10 all three at RPE 7 on 11-08 -> 45. Lean the torso forward so the hamstrings start long. 2 s on the way up. Let the right knee set how far you curl; the stretched part at the top matters more than the squeeze.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: 55: 10, 10, 8 at RPE 10 and form broke on set 3 -> hold 55. If set 3 drops below 8 reps, finish at 50. Full stretch at the top every rep: the lats are a big part of how wide your ribcage looks.

exercises.name: Pec Deck Fly
exercises.notes: 2 sets. 47x12 then 47x9 at RPE 10 on 11-08 -> back to 45 until both sets hit 12.

exercises.name: Side Bend
exercises.notes: NEW, obliques. One DB, free hand on your head. Lower toward the bell slowly (2 s), come up until you lean a little past vertical the other way. No twisting, no leaning back. 20 kg DB to start (you hold 24 for 60 s at RPE 6). Any back twinge: stop the exercise and tell me. 45 deg version: bodyweight, hip on the pad, same rules.

exercises.name: Machine Preacher Curl (drop set)
exercises.notes: First drop was 13 at 35, above the 10-12 target -> start 40, then 30, then 20. All to failure.

B.session_notes: What changed: Hip Thrust is now 2nd, right after bench. It got skipped twice for time, and it is your main glute lift. Squat machine 3 -> 2 sets. NEW Cable Woodchop for the obliques. Short on time: cut the seated row, never the hip thrust.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Bench Press - top set
exercises.notes: 75x3 was RPE 9 (RPE 8 on 10-12). Hold 75.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Bench Press - back-off
exercises.notes: 60x7 RPE 8, better than RPE 9 last time. Hold 60. First rep of each set paused 2 s.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust
exercises.notes: MOVED TO SLOT 2. Lower-glute cues: chin tucked, eyes forward (not at the ceiling), shins vertical at the top, tuck the pelvis and squeeze 2 s, stop at neutral. If you feel it in the hamstrings, move the feet closer. If you feel it in the quads, move them further out.

exercises.name: Squat Machine
exercises.notes: 2 sets now (was 3): less leg push, more glute. Hack squat 20x8 was RPE 6 -> 30. Log the weight on every set (set 1 came through blank). Other variants: weights do not carry.

exercises.name: Machine Seated Row
exercises.notes: 20x12 was RPE 9. Hold at 20 (your cap). First thing to cut if you are short on time.

exercises.name: Cable Woodchop
exercises.notes: NEW, obliques. High to low: cable above your head, arms long, rotate down across your body to the opposite knee. Turn through the ribs, let the back heel pivot, no arching. 2 s back up. 15 to start (your Pallof is 18-24, this one moves). Log the stack number.

exercises.name: Lying Incline DB Curl (drop set)
exercises.notes: 10 -> 7.5 -> 5. You got 10 on the first drop, so hold 10 and aim for 12.

C.session_notes: What changed: back extension is now glute-biased (toes out, upper back rounded) and is your lower-glute builder. Pallof press is OUT, Cable Woodchop 3x12/side replaces it. Wrist + reverse curl still go in the back extension rests.

exercises.name: Pull-Up Parallel Close Grip - top set
exercises.notes: +5 x5 was RPE 7, so +2.5 to 7.5. Stop the set AND the exercise on any catch in the back.

exercises.name: Pull-Up Parallel Close Grip - back-off
exercises.notes: Bodyweight 2x5 (RPE 7 on 11-02). Holds while the top set climbs.

exercises.name: 45 Back Extension (stop at neutral)
exercises.notes: NOW GLUTE-BIASED: toes turned out ~30 deg, pad just below the hip crease, upper back slightly rounded, chin tucked. Drive your hips into the pad with the glutes to come up, STOP AT NEUTRAL, never arch. 3x8 BW was RPE 7, so 10 reps. Once 3x12 is RPE 7, hold a 5 kg plate. Wrist + reverse curl superset in these rests.

exercises.name: DB Incline Bench Press
exercises.notes: 3x10 at 20 done but RPE 9. Hold 20 until the last set is RPE 8 or lower.

exercises.name: Cable Woodchop
exercises.notes: NEW, replaces the Pallof press (a hold builds less muscle than a moving lift). High to low, arms long, turn through the ribs, back heel pivots, no arching, 2 s back up. 15 to start. Log the stack number.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.notes: Finisher, straight sets. 17.5 (no 18 kg DB). 10/8/8 at RPE 9, so hold and get all three to 10.

D.session_notes: What changed: squat machine is OUT, Cable Pull-Through replaces it (glutes and hamstrings, spine-friendly hinge). That leaves the squat on Day B only, so you can now do D the day after B.

exercises.name: Cable Pull-Through
exercises.notes: NEW. Rope on the low pulley, face away, rope between your legs. Push the hips back until the hamstrings are stretched, knees soft, then stand up by squeezing the glutes. Stop at neutral, no leaning back. The deep stretch at the bottom is what builds the lower glute. 25 to start; if 12 is RPE 7 or easier, +5. DB RDL variant: start 2 x 17.5, weights do not carry.

exercises.name: Weighted Dip
exercises.notes: 5 kg 3x8 at RPE 8. Hold. Stop at ~90 degrees elbow, slight forward lean.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.notes: 35x12 was RPE 7 -> 40 (you have used 40 before).

exercises.name: Suitcase Hold (straps)
exercises.notes: 3 sets for the obliques. 24 kg x 60 s per side was RPE 6. When all 3 sets are RPE 7 or less, go 75 s, or 28 kg for 60 s if the gym has one (log the weight). Stand tall, do not lean away from the bell.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise (drop set)
exercises.notes: 7.5 -> 5 -> 2.5. 7.5 gave 10/10/8 at RPE 10, so it starts here.

H.session_notes: What changed: hip thrust moved up to 2nd, split squat 3 -> 2 sets and glute-biased, NEW sliding leg curl (hamstrings) and side plank hip dips (obliques). Pike and push-up are now one slot: pick pike if you are replacing Day A, a push-up if replacing B or C. Use this only to replace a missed gym day; it doesn't move the rotation. Every set ends 1-2 reps short of failure. Too easy (target at RPE 7)? Slow the lowering to 4-5 s or add a pause before adding reps. Warm-up at home: calf stretch on a stair, squat hold on a door frame, pancake sitting on a cushion.

exercises.name: Push
exercises.notes: Pike: 8, feet on bed for harder, head travels in front of the hands. Push-up variants: aim for 12, feet on bed if there is one, floor = 3 s down, 1 s chest on floor. End the set when the hips sag.

exercises.name: Single-leg Hip Thrust
exercises.notes: MOVED UP to slot 2, the main glute lift. Shoulders on bed or sofa (floor = glute bridge). Chin tucked, 2 s squeeze, ribs down, stop at neutral, never arch past straight.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.notes: 2 sets now (was 3), and glute-biased: front foot a bit further out, torso leaned forward ~30 deg, push through the front heel. Rear foot on bed or chair, 3 s down, ribs down, never arch to go deeper. Knee sets the depth.

exercises.name: Pull
exercises.notes: Chin-up 8 (palms toward you), RPE 8 cap, stop on any catch. No bar: door-frame row 12 per side, feet closer to the frame = harder. Towel row: stand on the push-to-open side so pulling shuts the door.

exercises.name: Sliding Leg Curl
variants: Lowering only (both up, slide out 4 s)
exercises.notes: NEW, hamstrings. On your back, heels on a towel (hard floor) or in socks, hips up in a bridge. Slide the heels out slowly (3 s) keeping the hips up, then pull them back in. Can't pull back yet? Use 'lowering only': slide out, drop the hips, walk the feet back in. Right knee sets how far you curl in.

exercises.name: Side Plank Hip Dip
exercises.notes: NEW, obliques (the side plank left the warm-up). On the forearm, feet stacked, lower the hip toward the floor and lift it higher than straight, 2 s pause at the top. Too easy: hold a water bottle or bag on the top hip. No top-leg raise.
